Definition: (only in dual) drawers (from concealing the private parts)
BiblicalUsage: The breeches are the linen drawers the priests wore beneath their robes, from the waist to the thighs, so that no nakedness showed when they served at the altar. God commanded them for Aaron and his sons, and Ezekiel still requires them of the priests in the restored temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God cares about modesty in worship: the priests were covered even where no one could see, because holiness reaches the parts of life nobody watches.
